Pride and Progress: San Francisco News – highlights: 1. With Casey Ward and Korey McCormack 2. GCN celebrates its 1st anniversary. 3. Ward and McCormack discuss recent events affecting the gay and lesbian community. 4. Happy Valentine's Day, from GCN COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 5. Ward and McCormack continue discussing recent events. 6. Discussion of a West Virginia Supreme Court case regarding a lesbian teacher 7. Interview with Irene Smith, massage therapist for people with AIDS 8. Speakers with San Francisco AIDS Foundation discuss impact of AIDS on women. 9. Report on Bishop William E. Swing regarding church liturgies for same-sex unions. 10. Report on Dutch National Broadcasting Corporation creation of gay and lesbian [teletext] service.
The Right Stuff: 1. With Karen Ripley 2. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby 3. Happy Valentine's Day, from GCN COMMERCIAL: Shanti Project, with Michael and Paula Smuin 4. Interview with Nancy Yerby, who talks about macrobiotic nutrition 5. Interview with Michael Prince, who talks about his music career and his single "Dance Your Love Away". Includes clip of music video. 6. Happy Valentine's Day, from GCN 7. Karen Ripley being comedic 8. Promotion of "Poetry & Well-Being" to benefit ACL's free art classes for people with AIDS 9. Interview with Frank Pike, who talks about his business Moonlighting Escorts. 10. Just Ask Raz COMMERCIAL: Cook's Magazine COMMERCIAL: The Best of "Money, Money, Money"
